summary: Count past 20, count big groups, say the number before or after one up to 20, and match numerals to amounts to 10.
Compare two groups by counting, see that one more or one less changes the count by one, and add or take away to 10.
Sort things one way, then another, and explain the rule; copy, extend and find the part that repeats in a pattern.
Put four or more things in order by size, pick a tool to measure with, and say how many blocks long something is.
Name and describe flat and some solid shapes, join shapes to make new ones, and use words like in front and behind.
